sentences.text: Gurmukh Singh vs State Of Punjab And Ors on 9 March, 2023

Neutral Citation No:=
 In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At

Gurmukh Singh ..Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Punjab And Others .. Respondents
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vinod S. Bhardwaj
Present None for the petitioner.
 Mr. Deepanjay Sharma, Dag, Punjab.
Vinod S. Bhardwaj, J. (Oral)

The instant writ petition had been filed espousing a grievance against respondents No.5 and 6 for illegally running a Hotel against the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and to direct the Authorities not to allow respondents No.5 and 6 to serve liquor to the customers at the premises.
A status report had been called for from the State.

Reply by way of affidavit of Sh. Sukhwinder Singh Brar, PPS, Deputy Superintendent of Police, Sub Division, Abohar, District Fazilka, has been filed wherein it has been averred that no Dhaba was found running at the spot and that it was noticed that the said respondents were running a Dhaba but the same was closed in the year 2021 due to Covid - 19 Pandemic and consequent financial losses and a statement of said owner-respondent No.6 had also been recorded which has been appended with the reply as R- 1/T.
There is no representation on behalf of the petitioner.
In view of the aforesaid reply and the status filed by the official respondents, it seems that no further grievance survives.
The present petition is accordingly disposed of as having been rendered infructuous.
Whether speaking / reasoned : Yes / No  Whether reportable : Yes / No
